dataset.name: pharos-heldout
dataset.labeling: Held-out set for codeqa_v1: four repositories and four languages (Python, TypeScript, Rust, C) that codeqa_v1 does not cover, pinned at the commits the free production deployment indexed on 2026-10-29. Queries and graded relevance were written by hand from reading the source at these commits, and labels were checked against parser output only; no retrieval was run on these queries before the file was written. 'behavior' queries paraphrase what the code does without naming identifiers; 'identifier' queries name the API. Grade 2 = the implementation asked about; grade 1 = closely related. Single annotator, who also ran the system: treat differences inside the bootstrap intervals as noise.
